caption:
If your pre-call research lived in OpenAI's Atlas browser, it stopped working. OpenAI's release notes say Atlas was deprecated and scheduled to stop working on 9 August 2026, with browser-based agentic capabilities folded into ChatGPT and Codex instead.

The habit is worth keeping even though the tab is gone. Ten minutes of research before a first call is the difference between "so, tell me about your business" and a question that makes them sit up.

The prompt below forces citations and an UNVERIFIED label, because the failure mode here is confident nonsense: wrong headcount, invented funding round, a director who left two years ago. Check every name and number on the company's own site before you say it out loud. Works in ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity.

Save this before your next first call. And tell me: how long do you actually spend on prep — ten minutes or none?

Keep the habit, move the tool.

slides.headline: Ask for a brief, not an essay.
slides.sub: Works in ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity. Paste the company name in.
slides.label: COPY THIS PROMPT
slides.code:
Research [company] before my call.
Use sources from the last 12 months.
Give me: what they sell, who buys,
3 recent changes, 2 problems I could
fix, 1 thing I should not say.
Cite a link for every claim.
Label anything unconfirmed as
UNVERIFIED. Do not guess.

body.t: Names, numbers, dates. Research agents invent headcount and funding rounds and quote people who left.
Check those three on the company's own site
You do not need a briefing document in the call. Take the two recent changes and ask
Then stop talking and write down the answer.
